title: [Critical] Case start hangs game until forced task kill â€” add persistent diagnostics
body:
## Live test report â€” BECK-LIVE-012

**Severity: Critical / case-play blocker**

On the current Windows test build, beginning an investigation case caused the game to grind to a halt immediately. It remained unresponsive until the tester forcibly terminated the process using Task Manager. No natural recovery or graceful shutdown was possible.

### Observed
- Castle hub launches; transition to an actual case triggers hang/severe unresponsiveness.
- Forced process/task kill required.
- Root cause unknown; do not label as confirmed deadlock without evidence.

### Required diagnosis
1. Add a startup/case transition stage trace with timestamps: request, teardown/scene transition, map generation/loading, entity creation, ghost initialization, equipment initialization, audio initialization, first render, gameplay-ready.
2. Persistent, append-only log written outside ephemeral install directories; flush stage markers immediately so the last successful stage survives Task Manager termination. Report log path in UI/help.
3. Frame timing and update/render split measurements, main-thread and worker queue timings, allocations/GC pauses and active entity counts, with bounded aggregation rather than per-frame log spam.
4. Thread heartbeat / hang watchdog (logging to disk; never itself block the render or simulation threads), thread dump support where practical, record active stage.
5. Error/uncaught-exception handlers; report build version, runtime/OS and active map/seed (excluding secrets).
6. Tests and a smoke run entering a case; ensure diagnostics persist after forced termination, and verify regression across maps.

### Acceptance
- Game transitions from hub to case and becomes responsive/playable.
- Diagnostic file identifies last case startup stage and timings on failures.
- Persistent diagnostic evidence survives a forced task kill.
- No fake success based solely on menu boot.

Related ongoing live-test defects: BECK-LIVE-001 through -011 (castle workstation, architecture, props, physics, missing shop).
